name: sample_documents
description: Return up to 5 real documents from a collection, optionally filtered and limited to some fields. Call it before relying on a field you have not seen yet - to confirm its exact name, type and shape (e.g. whether it is an array or nested), or to see what typical values look like. Do not use it to compute figures; use run_query for that.

collection.description: A data collection of the bank database (see the data dictionary), e.g. holdings.

filter.description: Optional MongoDB find filter, e.g. {"clientId": "CL-0001"}. Dates must be Extended JSON {"$date": "..."}.

fields.description: Optional fields to return (all fields when omitted).
